title: Buga Sphere matched to a 9-litre fuel tank

tellings.quote: So, there's a particular shape of fuel tank that is exactly 9 L and and it's got similar holes to the one that Yummy is relying on

plain: A metal ball found in Buga, Colombia, in 2025, which some people hold up as a strange object, may really be an ordinary fuel tank: there is a type of tank that holds exactly 9 litres and has holes like the ones on the sphere. The investigative journalist Ross Coulthart passes this on from a man named Ronnie Vernet, who made the match. If it holds, the sphere would be a piece of everyday hardware and not a mystery.
